name: Supple Switch (Combat)
body:
Your switch whip has a life of its own, avoiding damaging attacks from your foes while inflicting damage on them.

Prerequisite: Dex 13, Switch, seedling, base attack bonus +3.

Benefit: You gain a +2 racial bonus to your CMD against disarm and sunder attempts that target your switch whip.
